text:
Predicates:
CanRegisterVote(x) ::: x can register to vote in the United States.
ParticipateElection(x) ::: x participates in the 2024 United States presidential election.
HasUSCitizenship(x) ::: x has United States citizenship.
HasTaiwaneseCitizenship(x) ::: x has Taiwanese citizenship.
Official(x) ::: x is a Russian Federation official.
ManagerAtGazprom(x) ::: x is a manager at Gazprom.
Vladimir ::: the individual Vladimir.
Ekaterina ::: the individual Ekaterina.
Premises:
∀x (HasUSCitizenship(x) → CanRegisterVote(x)) ::: Anyone with US citizenship can register to vote.
∀x (HasUSCitizenship(x) ∨ HasTaiwaneseCitizenship(x)) ::: Everyone has either US or Taiwanese citizenship.
¬∃x (Official(x) ∧ HasTaiwaneseCitizenship(x)) ::: No Russian Federation official holds Taiwanese citizenship.
¬(HasTaiwaneseCitizenship(Vladimir) ∨ ManagerAtGazprom(Vladimir)) ::: Vladimir neither holds Taiwanese citizenship nor is he a manager at Gazprom.
EkaterinaCanRegisterOrOfficial ::: Ekaterina can register to vote or is a Russian Federation official.
Conclusion:
Vladimir ::: the individual Vladimir.
